name: preprod-check
description: Structured pre-production readiness audit across 16 categories (auth, input validation, billing integrity, rate limiting, cost containment, SSRF/uploads, secrets, headers/cookies, CORS, DB, logging, email/password flows, AI/LLM safety, performance, legal, ops). Fans the audit out across parallel sub-agents, verifies Critical/High findings, adapts to the detected stack, and produces a severity-grouped report with drafted patches.
